snippet.title: MASKED DEVOURER  | TRAILER | PS1 INDIE HORROR
snippet.description:
You play as young blogger, who loves filming her careless travels in forgotten and forbidden places. 

She doesn't believe in mysticism and all sorts of superstitions, but one day, wandering into a strange Japanese city, she completely changes her mind...

PS1 stealth indie horror
